findings.evidence: 1/1 product pages affected (100.0%). Example: markup says 49.00, page shows 129.00.
findings.mechanism: When markup and rendered text state different values, the discrepancy undermines trust in the markup generally, and an assistant may repeat a price the visitor never sees — which is worse than stating nothing.

suggested_action.expected_impact: Quoted attributes match what visitors see.
steps: Render the JSON-LD from the same data object that renders the page.
Include currency and validity dates on every offer.
Add a build check comparing markup price to rendered price.
suggested_action.summary: Generate markup and visible text from one source of truth so they cannot diverge.
